DTEK: 600,000+ without power in Dnipropetrovsk (Pavlohrad, Samarivskyi, Kamianske, Dnipro); ~250,000 in Kharkiv (Zlatopil mayor: no casualties); total ~850,000. Follows a larger attack a day earlier (five regions dark, Kyiv transmission hampered). Russia's Defence Ministry says it will continue strikes on fuel/energy infrastructure it says aids the military. Zelenskyy accuses Russia of intensifying pressure ahead of the Abu Dhabi talks (Tue-Wed).
sources.verificationBasis: Canonical aljazeera.com article (published 2026-11-08T12:20:17Z), full text in search result. Independently corroborated by Firstpost (published 2026-11-08T15:51:15+05:30) — same 850,000 total, same regional split, same Zelenskyy accusation — and by Tagesschau (via 24signal, 12:05 UTC) on the 600,000 Dnipropetrovsk figure.

sources.headline: Iran suggests blasts are not US attacks as both sides report ships hit
sources.note: On air no date was needed (published today). KEY HONESTY LINE, spoken on air: 'رائٹرز نے واضح کیا ہے کہ اس نے ان حملوں میں سے کسی کی بھی آزادانہ تصدیق نہیں کی ہے۔' Saturday-evening blasts in southern Iran incl. Qeshm; state TV: no missile strike on Iranian territory confirmed; Tasnim claims two missiles struck Qeshm (neither side commented). US: air force disabled a commercial vessel in the Gulf of Oman. IRGC Navy: two tankers caught fire after hitting mines in Hormuz; Fars: a third tanker exploded/caught fire. UKMTO: bulk-carrier incident ~18 nm east of Khor Fakkan, damage unknown. Sunday: Aramco admin building in Riyadh damaged by falling debris, no injuries. Qatar on Saturday denied reports the US-Iran deal had failed; Iran submitted a nuclear proposal via Qatar (Thursday) with seven demands incl. sanctions relief, frozen assets, war reparations; US insists nuclear issues feature in initial talks.
sources.verificationBasis: Canonical reuters.com article read in full in this run (page crawled 2026-11-08T14:28 UTC; exact wire timestamp not displayed, so publishedAt is the crawl time, flagged approximate). Independently corroborated by Al Jazeera's Iran war live updates (Qeshm hit, tankers on fire, Aramco debris) and the Sunday Guardian live blog (two tankers on fire after hitting mines; Iran blames unauthorised routes) — same events, same sequence. Reuters' own non-confirmation is recorded and was spoken on air.

sources.headline: Eisenkot to formally receive mandate to form government on Sunday
sources.note: On air no date was needed (published today). NEW DEVELOPMENT ONLY: the Saturday-night tasking was already in the 06:00 and 11:00 bulletins; this item carries today's formal Sunday ceremony, the 28-day clock (+14-day extension), and the recommendation numbers (67 for Eisenkot vs 46 for Netanyahu; his four-party bloc 48/120; Likud 27 single party; Netanyahu coalition 53). Eisenkot: 'national emergency government'. He has declined to join forces with Arab parties (19 seats) though their support would give him a majority. New Knesset members sworn in Tuesday evening.
sources.verificationBasis: Eastern Herald report (published 2026-11-08T06:58:43Z). Corroborated by Dawn's Reuters-credited report (dawn.com/news/2042866) and the Hindu BusinessLine (Nov 8) — same facts: Herzog's Saturday-night decision, Sunday ceremony, 28 days + 14-day extension, 67 vs 46 recommendations, 48-seat bloc, Arab-party difficulty.

sources.headline: Europeans will join Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, French foreign minister says
sources.note: On air no date was needed (published today). Barrot told RTL on Sunday that France will be in Abu Dhabi. Witkoff announced Monday that Washington would bring Ukraine and Russia delegations together in Abu Dhabi on 10-11 Nov to discuss ending the war, post-war security agreements and de-escalation.
sources.verificationBasis: Canonical reuters.com URL from search (last updated ~2h before the ~15:00 UTC search, i.e. ~13:00 UTC — publishedAt flagged approximate). Corroborated by Al Jazeera's Ukraine-strikes piece (Zelenskyy: pressure ahead of Abu Dhabi talks Tue-Wed) and Firstpost (talks scheduled Tuesday and Wednesday) — same talks, same dates.

sources.headline: Poland mourns victims of Krakow mass shooting as security fears grow
sources.note: On air no date was needed (published today). NEW DEVELOPMENT ONLY: the shooting itself was in the 00:00, 06:00 and 11:00 bulletins; this item carries only today's mourning and security response — two days of national mourning from Sunday, police bolstered security, Krakow old-town square closed, St Mary's trumpet call suspended 12 hours (first time since 1939), Warsaw security boosted. Six killed, 17 wounded incl. two police officers and the gunman; suspect 24, critical in hospital; his parents (53, 52) and sister (21) found dead at home.
sources.verificationBasis: Canonical reuters.com URL from search (last updated ~5h before the ~15:00 UTC search, i.e. ~10:00 UTC — publishedAt flagged approximate). Corroborated by Al Jazeera ('Poland mourns six killed in attack as authorities launch terrorism probe', 8 Nov 12:40) and Izvestia (PM Tusk: three bodies found at the suspect's home) — same mourning, same toll, same family deaths.

sources.headline: Pope Leo heads to Milei's Argentina as tensions loom over austerity, Iran
sources.note: On air no date was needed (published today). Pope heads Sunday to Argentina, second leg of a 12-day tour (Uruguay, Argentina, Peru, through 17 Nov); first US-born pope; first papal visit to Argentina since 1987; aged 71, less than a month after lung-cancer surgery. Speech to Milei closely watched: Church criticised Milei's austerity (inflation down from 200%+ to 33%); Milei strongly supported the Iran war, which Leo criticised.
sources.verificationBasis: Canonical reuters.com URL from search (last updated ~4h before the ~15:00 UTC search, i.e. ~11:00 UTC — publishedAt flagged approximate). Corroborated by the One Turn society listing (BBC News, Euronews, Le Monde: Pope Leo begins Latin America tour in Uruguay; 12-day tour; three weeks after lung-cancer surgery) — same tour, same health facts.

sources.headline: King leads nation in silence to honour war dead on Remembrance Sunday
sources.note: On air no date was needed (published today). King Charles III led the two-minute silence at the Cenotaph and laid the first wreath; ~10,000 veterans in the march-past incl. ~20 WWII veterans; a record nine former prime ministers present; PM Andy Burnham's first Remembrance Sunday in office; Archbishop of Canterbury Dame Sarah Mullally, the first woman in the role, led prayers. Carried under 'other agencies' as an original official source — no canonical bbc.com article URL with a publication time could be verified in this run, so the BBC section was omitted rather than filled from a secondary link.
sources.verificationBasis: UK government (gov.uk) news release (published 2026-11-08T00:01:01Z) for the plan and official details. The event having taken place today is confirmed by BBC-referenced reporting: Azat TV ('LONDON (BBC)', King led the silence, laid a wreath, ~10,000 veterans) and Nexus Europa (published 2026-11-08T13:00:51Z; record nine former PMs, Burnham's first as PM) — same ceremony, same figures.

sources.headline: 'Trump has cost us': After midterm losses, MAGA asks if it's over
sources.note: ANALYSIS ONLY — used solely for the clearly labelled 'اب تجزیہ' section, presented on air as Reuters' reporting/analysis, never as our own opinion and never as news fact. Trump promoted Stephen Miller to chief of staff on Friday, replacing Susie Wiles; Trump said it was 'largely true' the Iran war cost Republicans because it drove gasoline prices up; Reuters interviewed 12+ MAGA activists/strategists; PeakMetrics analysis: 20%+ of self-described MAGA loyalists raised doubts about the movement's leadership. crossVerified is false: this is analysis, and no second independent verification is claimed for its judgements.
sources.verificationBasis: Canonical reuters.com URL from search (last updated ~3h before the ~15:00 UTC search, i.e. ~12:00 UTC — publishedAt flagged approximate). The Miller appointment fact is separately corroborated by Guardian listings (RSSignals, 8 Nov). The analysis judgements are Reuters' own and are labelled as such in the record and on air.

sources.headline: PML-N wins PP-203 Sahiwal by-election (42,114 votes, Form-47); counting under way in NA-77 Gujranwala, PML-N leading

sources.note: Presented only as the judiciary's announcement (Mizan); the 'unfair trial' description is attributed to rights groups on air. sources.headline: Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant loses external power again, on diesel generators; IAEA says fuel for about two weeks
sources.note: On air no date was needed (published today). sources.verificationBasis: Canonical reuters.com article from search in this run.
